**Syrian Arab Republic: how applications changed.** The extract records 2,336,949 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 416,866 in 2015, compared with 72,014 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 21% lower than in 2019 (91,293). Applications in 2025 were 60% lower than in 2024 (181,407). In 2025, the leading destinations were Germany (41,266; 57%), Austria (4,481; 6.2%), Greece (3,940; 5.5%). Germany received 57% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 45% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 48%, across 35,266 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 54% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 46.9 percentage points lower than in 2024 (95%).
